biggest_catch: Account referrals demand a lot of the friend - $2,500 minimum deposit, $2,500 average balance for 90 days, and recurring direct deposit - and you won't even be told whether your referral was approved.
catches: Account referral: $100 sign-on bonus to the new customer; referrer gets $100. Friend must open with $2,500 min deposit, maintain $2,500 average minimum balance over 90 days, and have recurring direct deposit; paid after 90 days.
Loan referral: $100 paid upon closing of any NEW consumer loan, HELOC, or mortgage of $10K+; referred borrower can be new or existing customer.
Limit of 5 referrals per customer per year (applies to both tracks).
Referrer must be an existing customer; account referrals require a NEW customer.
1099-MISC reporting may apply; program can change or be cancelled at any time.
You will not be notified whether your referral is approved or declined (bank confidentiality).
